knowledge.title: Company docs
knowledge.desc: Product manuals, FAQs, certificates, pricing rules, case studies… keep them here. The assistant checks them first when writing articles, replying to inquiries and researching buyers, and tells you which document it relied on.
knowledge.unsupported: Can't read this format. PDF, Word (.docx), txt, md, csv and HTML files work; for anything else, copy the text and paste it.
knowledge.search_hint: This is the same search the assistant uses: type a few keywords to see which passages it finds. If nothing comes up, the docs don't cover it or it's worded differently.
knowledge.search_placeholder: e.g. MOQ lead time, CE certificate, warranty
knowledge.empty: Upload product manuals, spec sheets, FAQs, certificates, pricing rules or your company profile (PDF, Word, txt…), or add your site's product and About pages. The more complete they are, the more accurate the AI's content and replies; it won't invent what isn't there.
knowledge.no_summary: Not summarized yet. Click "AI summary" to have the assistant write a summary and tags.
knowledge.url_hint: Product pages, About, FAQ or blog posts on your site. The text on the page is saved.
knowledge.content_hint: Copy it from a document, email or chat.
knowledge.tags_hint: Separated by commas, e.g. manual, tablet
